content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Cloudflare digital

Cloudflare R2 is an innovative solution for storing and delivering digital products such as ebooks, templates, or software. It offers a cost-effective method of managing your digital assets without the overhead of traditional payment platforms. By utilizing R2, you gain complete control over your content, ensuring that your products are delivered directly to your customers without intermediary platforms that often charge high fees. This infrastructure is particularly crucial for creators in regions like Nigeria or Zimbabwe, where access to global payment solutions is severely limited. With R2, you can focus on creating while the technology handles the distribution seamlessly.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At the core of using Cloudflare R2 for digital product delivery is a combination of services that work together seamlessly. R2 provides object storage, where your digital files reside. When a customer makes a purchase, Cloudflare Workers can be employed to manage the transaction process and deliver the product. This is where NOWPayments comes into play, allowing for automated payment processing in various cryptocurrencies. The architecture ensures that every component plays a pivotal role: R2 for storage, Workers for logic execution, and NOWPayments for payment verification. This synergy creates a robust, efficient, and low-cost infrastructure for digital sales.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed specifically for digital creators who face limitations with mainstream payment processors. If you're selling ebooks, courses, or digital templates and find platforms like Gumroad or Stripe unavailable or prohibitive, this architecture is for you. It empowers creators in emerging markets like Kenya, Bangladesh, and Venezuela, enabling them to sell their products directly to consumers with minimal fees. With the Edge Commerce Stack, which can be deployed in just 48 hours, creators can have a fully functional store that handles everything from product listing to payment processing without relying on third-party platforms.
Cloudflare R2 offers scalable storage without the hefty fees of traditional platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The infrastructure consists of several key components. Cloudflare R2 serves as the storage solution for digital products, ensuring they are securely accessible. Cloudflare Workers facilitate the backend logic, managing customer interactions and product delivery. Supabase acts as the database for order management, while NOWPayments handles crypto payments without requiring user accounts. The Edge Commerce Stack combines these elements effectively, allowing creators to launch their stores quickly and efficiently. Each component is chosen for its reliability and cost-effectiveness, making it an ideal choice for creators looking to maximize their profits.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start using Cloudflare R2 for your digital product store, first, sign up for a Cloudflare account. Set up R2 for your digital product storage. Next, configure Cloudflare Workers to manage requests and deliver products upon payment confirmation. Integrate NOWPayments into your system for hassle-free cryptocurrency transactions. Finally, utilize a frontend framework or static site generator to present your products to customers. Each of these steps is crucial for establishing a streamlined and efficient digital sales process.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can utilize platforms that support crypto payments like NOWPayments. By integrating these systems with Cloudflare R2 for storage and delivery, you can create a fully functional online store without traditional payment barriers. This setup allows you to retain more of your sales revenue by avoiding high platform fees.
Using NOWPayments means you keep more of your sales revenue with only a 0.5% fee.

This stack includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and NOWPayments, ensuring a complete setup. For more details, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
